commands.sql:
SELECT c.group_code,
         c.company_id,
         c.member_id AS mem_code,
         c.card_no,
         c.card_type_id,
         c.card_type_name,
         c.card_status,
         c.card_status_name,
         c.is_main,
         c.card_sold_time,
         c.saled_shop_code,
         c.saled_shop_name,
         c.balance_principal,
         c.balance_gift,
         c.balance_point,
         c.balance_cashback,
         COALESCE(c.balance_principal,
         0) + COALESCE(c.balance_gift,
         0) AS balance_total,
         c.total_consume_money,
         c.total_consume_all_times,
         c.last_consume_time 
FROM dw.dwd_crm_member_card_p_store c 
WHERE c.group_code = #{SL_CRM_GC_ID} 
         AND ( '#{memberCodeCsv}' = ''
         OR instr(concat(',', '#{memberCodeCsv}', ','), concat(',', CAST(c.member_id AS STRING), ',')) > 0 ) 
         AND '#{omShopCodes}' <> '' 
         AND c.open_shop_id IN  
    ( SELECT crm_store_code 
    FROM dw.dw_sly_store_rel 
    WHERE group_code = '#{SL_UNIFIED_G_ID}' 
             AND store_code IN (#{omShopCodes}) ) 
ORDER BY  c.member_id, c.is_main DESC, c.card_sold_time DESC LIMIT #{limit};

         COUNT(DISTINCT c.mem_code) AS member_consume_user_count,

         AND CAST(rel.crm_store_code AS STRING) = CAST(c.trade_shop_id AS STRING)

         AND c.consume_time >= '#{startDate}'

         AND COALESCE(c.is_revoke, 0) = 0

    ( SELECT c.group_code,
         c.company_id,
         CAST(c.trade_shop_id AS STRING) AS trade_shop_id,
         c.store_name,
         c.mem_code,

    1 END) AS balance_member_count, ROUND(SUM(s.balance_total), 2) AS total_balance, ROUND(AVG(s.balance_total), 2) AS avg_balance, ROUND(AVG(s.days_since_last_consume), 1) AS avg_days_since_last_consume, ROUND(SUM(s.total_consume_amount), 2) AS total_consume_amount, ROUND(AVG(s.total_consume_amount), 2) AS avg_consume_amount, MAX(s.days_since_last_consume) AS max_days_since_last_consume, MIN(s.days_since_last_consume) AS min_days_since_last_consume 
FROM  
    ( SELECT r.group_code,
         r.company_id,
         r.mem_code,
         r.consume_count,
         r.total_consume_amount,
         r.last_consume_time,
         DATEDIFF('#{endDate}', r.last_consume_time) AS days_since_last_consume, COALESCE(b.balance_total, 0) AS balance_total, 
         CASE 
        WHEN DATEDIFF('#{endDate}', r.last_consume_time) >= #{lostDays} 
             AND (r.total_consume_amount >= #{highValueAmount}
             OR r.consume_count >= #{highFrequencyCount}) THEN
        '重点挽留' 
        WHEN DATEDIFF('#{endDate}', r.last_consume_time) < #{lostDays} 
             AND (r.total_consume_amount >= #{highValueAmount}
             OR r.consume_count >= #{highFrequencyCount}) THEN
        '重点保持' 
        WHEN DATEDIFF('#{endDate}', r.last_consume_time) >= #{lostDays} THEN
        '一般挽留' 
         ELSE '一般保持' 
         END AS rfm_segment 
    FROM  
        ( SELECT c.group_code,
         c.company_id,
         c.mem_code,
         COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(c.third_part_code,
         ''), CAST(c.code AS STRING))) AS consume_count, COALESCE(SUM(c.consume_bill_amount), 0) AS total_consume_amount, MAX(c.consume_time) AS last_consume_time 
        FROM dw.dwd_crm_member_consume_p_store c 
        WHERE c.group_code = #{SL_CRM_GC_ID} 
                 AND c.consume_time < '#{endDate}' 
                 AND c.consume_time >= DATE_SUB('#{endDate}', INTERVAL #{rfmHistoryDays} DAY) 
                 AND COALESCE(c.is_revoke, 0) = 0 
                 AND c.opt_code = 1 
                 AND '#{omShopCodes}' <> '' 
                 AND c.trade_shop_id IN  
            ( SELECT crm_store_code 
            FROM dw.dw_sly_store_rel 
            WHERE group_code = '#{SL_UNIFIED_G_ID}' 
                     AND store_code IN (#{omShopCodes}) ) 
            GROUP BY  c.group_code, c.company_id, c.mem_code ) r LEFT 
            JOIN  
                ( SELECT group_code,
         company_id,
         member_id AS mem_code,
         SUM(COALESCE(balance_principal,
         0) + COALESCE(balance_gift,
         0)) AS balance_total 
                FROM dw.dwd_crm_member_card_p_store 
                WHERE group_code = #{SL_CRM_GC_ID} 
                GROUP BY  group_code, company_id, member_id ) b
                     ON b.group_code = r.group_code 
                         AND b.company_id = r.company_id 
                         AND b.mem_code = r.mem_code ) s 
            GROUP BY  s.rfm_segment 
        ORDER BY  
         CASE 
    WHEN s.rfm_segment = '重点保持' THEN
    1 
    WHEN s.rfm_segment = '重点挽留' THEN
    2 
    WHEN s.rfm_segment = '一般保持' THEN
    3 
     ELSE 4 END;

  CASE

FROM (

    base.channel_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT base.bill_id) AS total_bill_count,

      - IF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN base.is_member_bill = '是' THEN NULL ELSE base.bill_id END) = 0, 0, SUM(CASE WHEN base.is_member_bill = '是' THEN 0 ELSE base.real_income END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN base.is_member_bill = '是' THEN NULL ELSE base.bill_id END)),
      2
    ) AS member_vs_non_member_avg_bill_diff,
    ROUND(IF(
      IF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN base.is_member_bill = '是' THEN NULL ELSE base.bill_id END) = 0, 0, SUM(CASE WHEN base.is_member_bill = '是' THEN 0 ELSE base.real_income END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN base.is_member_bill = '是' THEN NULL ELSE base.bill_id END)) = 0,
      0,
      (
        IF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN base.is_member_bill = '是' THEN base.bill_id END) = 0, 0, SUM(CASE WHEN base.is_member_bill = '是' THEN base.real_income ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN base.is_member_bill = '是' THEN base.bill_id END))
        - IF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN base.is_member_bill = '是' THEN NULL ELSE base.bill_id END) = 0, 0, SUM(CASE WHEN base.is_member_bill = '是' THEN 0 ELSE base.real_income END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN base.is_member_bill = '是' THEN NULL ELSE base.bill_id END))
      ) / IF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN base.is_member_bill = '是' THEN NULL ELSE base.bill_id END) = 0, 0, SUM(CASE WHEN base.is_member_bill = '是' THEN 0 ELSE base.real_income END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN base.is_member_bill = '是' THEN NULL ELSE base.bill_id END))

  FROM (
    SELECT
      b.store_code,
      b.store_name,
      b.id AS bill_id,
      b.real_income,
      b.people_qty,
      b.is_member_bill,
      CASE
        WHEN gb.bill_id IS NOT NULL OR b.settle_info LIKE '%团购%' THEN '团购'
        WHEN b.sale_type_name = '外卖' OR b.order_type_name LIKE '%外卖%' OR COALESCE(b.o2o_source_name, '') <> '' THEN '外卖'
        WHEN b.sale_type_name = '堂食' THEN '堂食'
        ELSE COALESCE(b.sale_type_name, '其他')
      END AS channel_name
    FROM dw.dwd_pos_bill_p_store b
    LEFT JOIN (

        bill_id
      FROM dw.dwd_pos_groupbuy_paydetail_p_store
      WHERE group_code = #{SL_CY7_GROUP_ID}
        AND settle_time >= '#{startDate}'
        AND settle_time < '#{endDate}'

    ) gb

     AND gb.store_code = b.store_code
     AND gb.bill_id = b.id
    WHERE b.group_code = #{SL_CY7_GROUP_ID}
      AND b.table_settle_time >= '#{startDate}'
      AND b.table_settle_time < '#{endDate}'

          AND store_code IN (#{omShopCodes})
      )
  ) base
  GROUP BY
    CAST(base.store_code AS STRING),
    base.store_name,
    base.channel_name
) r
ORDER BY

  r.member_revenue_ratio,

    THEN cohort.mem_code
  END) AS repurchase_30d_member_count,
  ROUND(

      COUNT(DISTINCT cohort.mem_code) = 0,

        WHEN cohort.first_consume_time IS NOT NULL

  ROUND(
    IF(
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN cohort.first_consume_time IS NOT NULL
          AND DATE_ADD(cohort.first_consume_time, INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY) <= '#{observeEndDate}'
        THEN cohort.mem_code
      END) = 0,
      0,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN cohort.first_consume_time IS NOT NULL
          AND DATE_ADD(cohort.first_consume_time, INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY) <= '#{observeEndDate}'
          AND consume.consume_time > cohort.first_consume_time

SELECT
  m.previous_segment,
  m.current_segment,
  COUNT(1) AS member_count,
  ROUND(SUM(m.previous_total_consume_amount), 2) AS previous_total_consume_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(m.current_total_consume_amount, 0)), 2) AS current_total_consume_amount,
  ROUND(AVG(m.previous_days_since_last_consume), 1) AS previous_avg_days_since_last_consume,
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(m.current_days_since_last_consume, #{lostDays})), 1) AS current_avg_days_since_last_consume,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.previous_segment = '高价值' AND m.current_segment <> '高价值' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_outflow_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.previous_segment <> '高价值' AND m.current_segment = '高价值' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_inflow_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.previous_segment = '高价值' AND m.current_segment = '沉睡' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_to_sleep_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.previous_segment = '高价值' AND m.current_segment = '流失' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_to_lost_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.previous_segment = '沉睡' AND m.current_segment = '流失' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sleep_to_lost_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    p.group_code,
    p.company_id,
    p.mem_code,
    p.consume_count AS previous_consume_count,
    p.total_consume_amount AS previous_total_consume_amount,
    p.last_consume_time AS previous_last_consume_time,
    p.days_since_last_consume AS previous_days_since_last_consume,
    p.member_segment AS previous_segment,
    c.consume_count AS current_consume_count,
    c.total_consume_amount AS current_total_consume_amount,
    c.last_consume_time AS current_last_consume_time,
    c.days_since_last_consume AS current_days_since_last_consume,
    COALESCE(c.member_segment, '流失') AS current_segment
  FROM (
    SELECT
      r.group_code,
      r.company_id,
      r.mem_code,
      r.consume_count,
      r.total_consume_amount,
      r.last_consume_time,
      DATEDIFF('#{previousMonthEndDate}', r.last_consume_time) AS days_since_last_consume,
      CASE
        WHEN DATEDIFF('#{previousMonthEndDate}', r.last_consume_time) >= #{lostDays} THEN '流失'
        WHEN DATEDIFF('#{previousMonthEndDate}', r.last_consume_time) >= #{sleepDays} THEN '沉睡'
        WHEN r.total_consume_amount >= #{highValueAmount} OR r.consume_count >= #{highFrequencyCount} THEN '高价值'
        ELSE '普通'
      END AS member_segment
    FROM (
      SELECT
        c.group_code,
        c.company_id,
        c.mem_code,
